text:
Nora: Flagging — customer 'helios' reporting a burst of duplicate service accounts from SCIM after we rolled the RBAC role rename + a Secrets team key rotation. Provisioner logs show KMS Decrypt failures and then fallback creates. Can infra/security triage?

Felix: ACK. Paste the smallest logs and any SCIM sample.

Nora: Logs (sanitized):
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 200 OK
{
  "externalId": "ENCRYPTED:v1:...",
  "userName": "svc-helios-ingest"
}
2026-06-14T04:12:19Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt extid failed: kms.Decrypt AccessDeniedException
2026-06-14T04:12:19Z INFO provisioner: fallback to userName -> created svc-helios-ingest-2
```

Jun: AccessDenied suggests key policy change or alias pointed at new key. infra-bot, any KMS alias updates for alias/tenant-extid-helios around 04:10Z?

infra-bot: KMS: 2026-06-14T04:09:50Z AliasUpdate alias/tenant-extid-helios -> keyId=kkk-900; KeyPolicy changed: added Principal arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/partner-sync (stmt[3]).

Priya: Adding an external partner role to the extid key is a high-risk change. We need timeline/scope for a vuln triage. Also audit logs show missing deprovision events for 04:10-04:20Z for helios. Our deprovision step currently decrypts before logging.

Felix: Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause SCIM inbound for helios (cs-rep please coordinate); 2) Rollback alias or remove partner principal from key policy and re-add provisioner role; 3) Add shallow-audit shim in provisioner so we always emit an audit row (ciphertext_hmac + reason) before decrypt.

cs-rep: Notifying customer and pausing provisioning now. Message approved: "We detected a configuration change to an internal key that briefly impacted provisioning. We've paused provisioning and are investigating. We'll follow up within 24 hours."

Nora: Good. Felix/Nina: can you run a quick query for Decrypt/ReEncrypt calls to kkk-900 in the last hour and list principals? We need to know if partner role called Decrypt or just Encrypt.

Jun: Query result (infra-bot): 2026-06-14T04:09:51Z..04:18:00Z -> Decrypt calls=34; principals: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/provisioner (22), arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/partner-sync (12).

Priya: 12 Decrypts from the partner role = unacceptable. Start vuln triage: notify legal and run immediate blast-radius: list tenants with alias/tenant-extid-helios mapping and any rewraps. Create incident SEC-2026-099.

security-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-099 "SCIM dupes & potential extid exposure — partner principal added to KMS key policy" https://redwood.incidents/SEC-2026-099

Felix: Fix plan: 1) Put back the prior key alias while we lock down policy; 2) Re-apply key policy ensuring arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/provisioner has Decrypt/ReEncrypt rights and partner role only has Encrypt if needed; 3) Run server-side ReEncrypt rewrap (preserve EncryptionContext) for affected extids; 4) Run recon to merge duplicates; 5) Ship audit-shim + create-guard to avoid blind creates on decrypt failure.

Nora: Who owns rewrap? Felix and infra. Who owns recon? Priya. Who owns customer comms? cs-rep + legal.

Jun: Short-term guard: change provisioner to not auto-create on decrypt failure — instead enqueue to dedupe-review with ciphertext-hmac. Quick hotfix PR coming.

Felix: Rolling key policy rollback now. Will post command output.

infra-bot: put-key-policy executed at 2026-06-14T04:25:03Z. Post-change audit: no Decrypt calls from partner role after 04:25:10Z.

Priya: I'll open PR for audit-shim and tests that simulate KMS errors. Tests will assert an audit row exists with reason="kms-decrypt-failure" and ciphertext_hmac present.

Nora: OK team — proceed with rewrap dry-run in staging, recon plan, and coordinated customer update. Post statuses here and escalate if anything unexpected. :white_check_mark:
